international.title: Anthropic sets share price at $83 for stock market debut, above expected range
international.summary: Artificial intelligence firm positioned for one of the biggest IPOs in history, with trading slated to begin Thursday Anthropic set the share price for its debut on the US stock market at $83 on Wednesday, positioning the artificial intelligence company for one of the biggest initial public offerings in history. The firm is slated to begin trading on Thursday under the ticker symbol ANT, with CEO Dario Amodei and other co-founders ringing the bell to open the Nasdaq exchange. The San Francisco-based company, founded in 2021, set a preliminary share price of $70 to $78 last week. With all shares counted, those prices put Anthropic’s initial public offering (IPO) from $1.26tn to $1.41tn, which would rank it as the second-biggest market offering ever. Elon Musk’s SpaceX debuted on Wall Street in June with a $1.77tn valuation. Continue reading...
